## Completed checks

- Compared the new manuscripts with the preceding substantive versions. The equations, formal statements and proof wording are unchanged; proof paragraphs were divided for readability. Appendix text is unchanged apart from whitespace.
- Checked the additional exposition against the existing definitions and results. A5 adds the Skipper comparison and corrects the Holguín reference. A6 adds the finite-model qualifier, clarifies the option-ranking criterion and explicitly specifies a normal situation in the Bjorn comparison.
- Re-read the primary-source passages identified in [the final assessment](FINAL-REVIEW.md). These were targeted source and argument checks, not an exhaustive originality search.
- Regenerated the three anonymous essay PDFs and their matching anonymized reports. Checked extracted text, blank identifying metadata, missing-glyph and overflow warnings, and page bounds. No such defect was found.
- Visually inspected all 46 pages of the six individual PDFs. The combined reading copy contains the same 34 essay pages, in A5–A6–A4 order, with three navigation bookmarks.
- Checked the version and word-count pairing, package links and archive contents. The package contains the manuscripts, PDFs, reports and concise review documents; it does not contain internal run logs or human-input histories.

Claude's final numerical audit was read. Its reported computations and the earlier computation suites were not rerun in this pass because the mathematical content and numerical examples did not change. Those earlier checks are described as earlier work in the matching reports.

The review found no new defect in the central proof arguments inspected. It does not certify originality or philosophical importance. A4 remains the less secure third candidate. The published *Good Guesses* version comparison remains open, and a fresh full-text copy of Wysocki's article was not obtained in this pass. See [the final assessment](FINAL-REVIEW.md) for the remaining questions and access limits.
